newsitem.title: BELGIUM: De Silguy encouraged by French gvt audit response.
newsitem.headline: De Silguy encouraged by French gvt audit response.

text.p: The European Union's Economic Affairs Commissioner, Yves-Thibault De Silguy, said on Monday the French government's response to the public finance audit had been "encouraging" and that the budget clean-up measures announced went in the right direction.
In a statement he said that what was needed now was fine-tuning by France on the deficit, but that Paris should not slow down in its efforts.
"The response of the French government to the results of the public finance audit is encouraging. The budget clean-up measures announced go in the right direction," he said in the statement.
He said that the hardest had been done in efforts to reduce the budget deficit, which had fallen to 4.2 pct in 1996 from 5.6 pct in 1993.
"What remains to be done is fine-tuning," he said in the statement. "They should not slow down efforts now that we are on the home strait," he said.
